calculation_handling.description: Inclusion rule: the area under an exterior barrier-free access ramp or elevating device counts as landscaping.
calculation_handling.gaps: We hold no data on barrier-free access ramps or elevating devices.

5.10.50.10(1).explanation: The ground covered by an exterior ramp or lift that gives barrier-free access to the first floor counts as landscaping, so it helps meet landscaping requirements.
